sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — includes six neck vertebrae and a partial right hip bone.
Scientists estimate the total body length of this animal was between 2 and 3 meters.
The holotype specimen was discovered near the eastern banks of the Don River in the Ilovlinsky District of Volgograd Oblast.
Fossils of Bystrowisuchus have been found in the Olenekian-age Lipovskaya Formation in the Ilovlinsky District.
The genus Bystrowisuchus was described by Sennikov in 2012.
Bystrowisuchus is classified as an archosauromorph.
It belongs to the order Rauisuchia.
The animal is classified within the family Ctenosauriscidae.
Bystrowisuchus lived during the Early Triassic period.
